name: clarvis
description: Clippy's presence. Jarvis's competence. A butler's disdain.

commands.title: Clarvis: Set Fish Audio API Key
Clarvis: Clear Fish Audio API Key

clarvis.watch.minDurationSeconds.description: Tasks/commands/debug sessions shorter than this are tracked but never notified about.

enumDescriptions: Anthropic API with your own key. Best tool calling.
OpenRouter — one key, many models. Use "Clarvis: Choose Model" for the filtered list.
Ollama on this machine. No key, nothing leaves it.
LM Studio on this machine. No key, nothing leaves it.
clarvis.chat.provider.description: Which model provider to use. No Claude-subscription option: Anthropic does not permit third-party products to use claude.ai logins without prior approval.

clarvis.chat.model.description: Model name. Empty uses the provider's default. Run "Clarvis: Choose Model" for a picker — on OpenRouter it lists only models that can call tools.

enumDescriptions: Use the same provider as chat.
Anthropic API with your own key.
clarvis.agent.provider.description: Provider for writing code and running the agent. Empty follows the chat provider — set it to keep a cheap model for chat and a capable one for code.

clarvis.agent.model.description: Model for writing code and running the agent. Empty follows the chat model. Run "Clarvis: Models" to set it.

clarvis.chat.baseUrl.ollama.description: Override the Ollama endpoint. Empty means http://localhost:11434.

clarvis.chat.baseUrl.lmstudio.description: Override the LM Studio endpoint. Empty means http://localhost:1234.

clarvis.chat.baseUrl.openai.description: Override the OpenAI endpoint, for a proxy or gateway. Empty means the official API.

clarvis.voice.enabled.description: Speak briefings, task outcomes and chat replies aloud. Off until you ask for it — a voice that surprises you once is a voice you disable forever. Clarvis offers to set it up once, on first run.

clarvis.voice.selectedVoice.description: Voice to speak with: 'curated:default' for the shipped voice, 'fish:<reference_id>' for a specific Fish Audio voice, or 'system' for the OS voice.

clarvis.voice.savedVoices.description: Fish Audio voices you have named, as { "name": "<reference_id>" }. Added by the voice picker when you paste an ID; delete one by removing its line here.

clarvis.voice.fishAudio.engine.description: Fish Audio TTS engine. Quality vs speed vs cost; the default is their current best model on a free developer tier.

clarvis.voice.dailyRequestCap.description: Fish Audio requests per day before dropping to the system voice. A butler should not run up a bill while you're at lunch.
